closedFindings: Question 7's awkward 'over only major mistakes' distractor was revised to 'only over major mistakes' after the first key-hidden review.
The first review tool used a repeating four-position cycle; its 10/10 result was discarded and items 01–20 were reviewed again under a stable hash shuffle.
Question 21's awkward 'take turns peacefully over who' distractor was rewritten as natural English.
Question 26's internally contradictory 'Yes ... fight' distractor was replaced with a plausible changed-issue foil.
Question 36's internally contradictory advice/reasons were replaced with coherent alternative scenarios.
Question 39's implausible 'expected success because they fight' foil was replaced with a changed-reaction foil.
Question 46's implausible 'aunt wanted them to fight' foil was replaced with a duration near miss.
Question 48's unnatural 'Before years of fighting' foil was rewritten as a natural sentence with the wrong sequence.
Question 56's correct English answer now preserves who uses the shared oven first, matching its source prompt and Chinese answer.
